appliedUpdates.description: Updated test-math command to reference actual test files (tests/test_embedding.py tests/test_vector_store.py) instead of non-existent test_suite.py

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document preference for component-organized tests over consolidated test suites. The project structure uses tests/test_<component>.py files which is preferable for maintainability.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: mathematical-test-suite feature distributed tests across test_embedding.py and test_vector_store.py rather than creating a single test_suite.py. This aligns with existing project conventions.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document preference for omitting obsolete 'version' attribute in docker-compose.yml files for cleaner configuration with modern Docker Compose.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: docker-setup feature used 'version: 3.8' which generates warnings in modern Docker Compose. This is cosmetic but worth documenting.

rejectedObservations.reason: Skill changes should be handled by skill maintainers, not applied directly. The component test organization is actually preferable.
